description: This file defines the Zend_Validate_Ip class, which is a validator for IP addresses supporting both IPv4 and IPv6, with configurable options. It includes methods for setting options, validating IPv4 and IPv6 addresses, and checking whether a given value is a valid IP address.

classes.name: Zend_Validate_Ip
classes.description: A validator class for checking whether a given value is a valid IP address, supporting IPv4 and IPv6 with configurable options.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor method for initializing IP validator with options.

methods.name: setOptions
methods.description: Sets validator options such as allowing IPv4 and IPv6.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Checks if a given value is a valid IP address based on current options.
